description: Enumerates every 0-based start index at which an IUPAC recognition pattern occurs in a sequence, on the GIVEN STRAND ONLY. This is the raw pattern scan underneath find_restriction_sites, exposed for a caller that holds a pattern rather than an enzyme: no enzyme, no cut arithmetic, no reverse-strand scan and no linear-molecule cut-feasibility filter. Overlapping occurrences are all reported, in ascending order. Matching is Biopython Bio.Restriction's site-regex rule: a pattern N matches any of the 15 IUPAC codes in the sequence (an N included), every other pattern code matches only a concrete A/C/G/T base it expands to — so "GAANTC" does NOT match GAATTC and "GTYRAC" does NOT match GTYRAC — and a character outside the 15 codes matches nothing. Both the sequence and the pattern may carry IUPAC codes and the scan is case-insensitive. To cover both strands, call again with the reverse complement of the pattern. A null or empty sequence yields no occurrences; an invalid pattern is an error. Call to locate a recognition pattern, a degenerate site or a cloning scar when no enzyme is involved.

sequence.description: Sequence to scan. IUPAC ambiguity codes are accepted anywhere; null or empty yields no occurrences.

recognition_pattern.description: Recognition pattern: 1 or more of the 15 IUPAC nucleotide codes A, C, G, T, N, R, Y, S, W, K, M, B, D, H, V (case-insensitive).

start_index.description: First index to consider; occurrences starting before it are skipped. Defaults to 0, must not be negative.

positions.description: 0-based start indices of the pattern on the given strand, ascending; overlapping occurrences are all reported.
